_note: Production drawing conventions, mined live from 194 compiled panels across 59 plants (round 1: 39 panels/15 plants; round 2 added the 3050-3119 fleet incl. Swedish/Danish stores and large non-supermarket buildings). Plant ids masked in committed claims. This is the 'how we draw panels today' ground truth behind AI-BRIEFING section 7b.

standard_inventory: Ventilasjon 360.NNN (one per vent system, TFM-style system number)
panel_taxonomy.naming: Norwegian names; ventilation panels carry the system number ('Ventilasjon 360.001', '36.01 Ventilasjon', 'System 360.02'). Swedish stores: 'Oversikt Butik', 'Larmoversikt'; Danish: 'Overblik Butik' - often single-panel plants.
panel_taxonomy.big_buildings: Town halls / malls run 40-216 panels (one per system) with building-specific names

panel_size.note: 1400x755 is the designer's own Actions-menu preset ('Set PanelSize 1400x755'); 1400x750/755 dominate newer plants, 1280x1024 the older fleet.
panel_size.rule: one size per plant - ALWAYS match the plant's existing panels

backgrounds.rule: 96% of the 194-panel corpus has a background image (floor plan for Oversikt, schematic drawing for Maskin/VGV/Waterloop, meter drawing for Energi; 18 of the 186 are the 00-blank templates). Objects are placed ON TOP of the artwork.
backgrounds.blank_usage: Ventilasjon panels are often drawn object-only on the blank-sidebar template (ducts/pipes/boxes as objects)
backgrounds.cross_plant_reuse: Background PNGs are routinely copied from sister stores (a panel on one plant referencing another plant's image name, sometimes an absolute /iw_plants/iw_<id>/images/... path)

linking_conventions.finished_panels_linked_pct: 88-100% of objects carry a real plant-prefixed driver_id
linking_conventions.link_tag_usage: Rare on Oversikt/Maskin (0-6%); HIGH on Energi panels (25-100% - energy-meter tags); alias_text in production is typically the linked param's name, e.g. 'u58 Comp1/LLSV' (unit number + param name)

corpus_wide_facts.containers: 3 of 194 panels use containers - they are RARE in production
corpus_wide_facts.graphics: 0 of 194 panels carry graphics[] elements - the d3 graphics layer is effectively unused in the compiled fleet
corpus_wide_facts.legacy_V2_world: Older plants (3xxx fleet, SE/DK stores) are drawn with V2-era object ids: alarm_anim.gif, number, number1..numberNN, red_led_small, sub_page_1/sub_page_4. These still render (the controls registry keeps ~880 V2 defs) but are NOT the modern style - never emit them in new panels; use the V3 allowlist.

the_case_cluster._what: THE recurring Oversikt pattern: one cluster per cooling position (disk/rom), placed over that position on the floor plan. Mined from 16 Oversikt panels: 28 clean occurrences of the 4-member cluster + 11 of a 3-member variant without the cooling symbol (alarm + temp + defrost).

members_and_median_offsets_from_cluster_.role: cooling status (bottom-left, tucked under the box)

the_case_cluster.linking: all four members link to the SAME unit (case controller): alarm, air temp, cooling relay, defrost relay

other_recurrences.fan_pairs: two V3_25px_anim_fan_nrm stacked vertically ~27px apart (condenser/gas-cooler fans on Oversikt)
other_recurrences.room_control: label + number_v3_rc_box + number_v3_rc_temp_48 (+ fan) stacks on room panels
other_recurrences.energi_stacks: number_v3_60px_json_obj / number_v3_custom_json_obj in vertical columns (~48px pitch) under a bold label, link_tag-driven

per_type_dominant_objects.Maskin: number_v3_value_only en masse over the schematic + V3_akpc_* state strips + V3_ok_alarm_nrm + LEDs
per_type_dominant_objects.Ventilasjon: exhaust/inlet/supply duct objects + number_v3_R_45px_con_* boxes along the ducts + fans + filters

ai_implications: A production-grade Oversikt/Maskin panel is artwork + objects. The AI cannot produce the PNG, so it has TWO modes: (A) blank table-style panel (no background, works immediately - like generated-panel-example.json); (B) CLUSTER KIT for an existing background: emit one case cluster per cooling position from the customer's case list, laid out in a neat grid with 90px column pitch / 90px row pitch, each cluster's alias_text naming its position ('Disk 1 Melk', 'Rom 3 Frys') - the human inserts, then drags each cluster onto the floor plan.
Respect the plant's panel size (1400x750 default).
Panel names follow the taxonomy (Oversikt, Maskin, Energi, Ventilasjon 360.NNN, VGV, Waterloop, Kondenssystem).
